items.label: Voice
items.desc: Voice principles, glossary, and copy rules
items.title: Anthropologie voice principles
items.lead: One voice for the master brand and every label. The tone shifts by channel.
items.positioning: Anthropologie is unique, just like you. We write like a friend with great taste: warm, curious, and specific.
claims: Warm: talk with people, not at them. Never pushy.
Curious: tell the story behind the piece.
Uncommon: specific words, never stock retail phrases.
items.rule: Hyphenate compound adjectives before a noun: wide-leg pants, only-here finds.
items.ask: Is it wide leg or wide-leg?
items.answer: **Wide-leg**, with a hyphen, when it describes a noun: wide-leg pants, wide-leg jeans. From the glossary in Brand voice.

items.label: Brand
items.title: Our palette
items.rule: Let the photo lead on ivory and taupe. Anthropologie blue is for small accents and links.
items.ask: Which color should a social post lead with?
items.answer: Lead with the photo on **ivory and taupe**, and keep **Anthropologie blue, #167A92**, for small accents and links.

items.label: Creative
items.title: Photography
items.lead: Real people with personality, never posed.

do.label: Natural and expressive
do.note: People moving freely, in clean, simple settings.

dont.label: Posed for the camera
dont.note: No forced smiles or stock poses.

items.ask: Can I use a stock photo of shoppers smiling at the camera?
items.answer: Better not. The photography guidelines ask for **natural, expressive people**, and **no forced smiles or stock poses**.

items.label: Everyday
items.desc: Short rules for email, decks, and docs
items.title: Email tone of voice
items.lead: The short version of our tone of voice, for everyone who sends email.
rules: Say what you need in under eight words.
Lead with the ask or the answer.
Use the standard signature. No quotes or images.
items.do: Can you review the launch plan by Thursday?
items.dont: Just circling back on the below!!
items.askLabel: Before sending, with Claude or Gemini
items.ask: Check this email against our writing guidelines.
items.answer: Two fixes before you send: **put the ask in the first line**, and **use the standard signature**.

tabs.label: Email
tabs.ask: Check this email against our email tone of voice before I send it.
tabs.intro: Three fixes based on **Everyday › Email tone of voice**:

before.subject: Following up
body: Hi team, just circling back on the below!!
We've been heads-down on the Anthropologie holiday campaign and there's a lot going on, so I wanted to share where things stand.
Can you review the launch plan by Thursday?

after.subject: Review the holiday campaign plan by Thursday
body: Hi team, can you review the holiday campaign plan by Thursday?
It covers the messaging, launch assets, and timeline. Comments in the doc are perfect.

fixes.label: Subject:
fixes.note: say what you need. "Following up" doesn't.

fixes.label: Opening:
fixes.note: lead with the ask. It's in the last line right now.

fixes.label: Sign-off:
fixes.note: use the standard signature, with no quotes.

tabs.done: Updated. The draft matches the email tone of voice and is ready to send.

placements.label: Window
placements.where: Both windows, centered at eye level, above the display.
placements.content: One campaign story per window. Hang the graphic as it arrives, with the display styled below it.
placements.ask: Which window does the holiday graphic from the mailer go in?
placements.answer: **Both windows**, centered at eye level, **above the display**. Hang it as it arrives: the headline is already in sentence case, so nothing gets added or rewritten in store.

placements.label: Front table
placements.where: Front edge of the first table inside the door, facing the entrance.
placements.content: Headline and one line of copy. Gifts styled in small groups, not stacks.
placements.ask: What goes on the front table this week?
placements.answer: The **Gifts under $50** edit, with the **table header facing the entrance**. Style gifts in small groups, not stacks.

placements.label: Shelf
placements.where: Top of each wall fixture, at eye level.
placements.content: One product story per fixture, never two.
placements.ask: Can one shelf topper cover knits and candles?
placements.answer: **No. One product story per fixture.** Give candles their own topper on the next fixture.

placements.label: Register
placements.where: Left of the register, angled toward the customer.
placements.content: One add-on offer. Small gifts get price strips only.
placements.ask: What sign goes at the register this month?
placements.answer: One **counter card, left of the register**, angled toward the customer. For Holiday it is Add a gift card. Small gifts get **price strips only**.
